title: Existence of compatible open restriction choices
statement: For f:X→S, g:S′→S with g and g′ flat, F an O_X-module, I an injective resolution of F, J an injective resolution of g′^*F, and every open V⊂S, FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V is inhabited. This requires the canonical restricted unit square, the augmentation-preserving resolution isomorphisms and the pinned section components in [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], not arbitrary section isomorphisms.

proof.text: Construct the restricted resolution termwise. Finite limits and colimits of overFunctor are preserved by moduleOverFunctor_limits_proof and moduleOverFunctor_colimits_proof; transport these across overFunctorEquiv. Use module_open_restriction_injectives to preserve injectivity, then transport it through overEquiv and overFunctorEquiv. Define the augmentation using singleMapHomologicalComplex and prove its degree-zero equation by singleMapHomologicalComplex_inv_app_self. The comparison of complexes is the identity.

Construct the section-complex isomorphism degreewise as restrictAppIso at the top open followed by presheaf.mapIso of the equality U.ι_image_top. Naturality of each differential gives the cochain comparison. Its components are exactly the pinned components by simplification of isoOfComponents and equality transport. Apply this construction separately to I on U and J on W.

Compose the canonical tensor-pullback unit with the target restriction unit and pushforwardComp W.ι h. Identify its codomain with pushforward U.ι of pushforward r via the inverse of E = pushforwardComp r U.ι followed by pushforwardCongr of resLE_comp_ι. Define psi by the inverse restriction-adjunction homEquiv applied to this composite. The homEquiv apply_symm_apply identity, homEquiv_unit, and cancellation of E.inv with E.hom prove unit_square. Bundle psi and the two constructed restricted resolutions.

from.place: lem-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-map-sections: Existence of compatible open restriction choices

lean.statement:
theorem flatBaseChangeMap_sections_choices {X S S' : Scheme.{uBC}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    [Flat g] [Flat (pullback.snd g f)] (F : X.Modules) :
    ∀ (I : InjectiveResolution F)
      (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F)) (V : S.Opens),
      Nonempty (FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V)
